notes: Round 1 (days 57-84), each candidate alone vs no covariates, 28-day windows: X01 +0.4% (neutral), X02 -5.0%, X03 -11.0% (nearly significantly harmful). Round 2 (days 85-112): X04 alone +13.6% [+1.9,+25.7], but its weekly skills fell from +27.8 to -8.9. X01 re-screened: +18.9% [+4.2,+32.8], 19/9 days, positive in the last three weeks. It appears to have switched on around day 78. Round 3 (E6, days 99-126): X04 added to X01 gave +1.5% [-2.6,+5.9], 15/13 days, weekly -1.7 to +3.6. No detectable added value. Limitations: X01 was not directly re-tested against no covariates on days 113-126, so its persistence there is inferred from E5's trend, not measured. X02 and X03 were only tested on days 57-84.
